detail.longDescription: 🤖 Chainalysis disclosed a breach where an external actor used "offensive agentic techniques" to reach internal tools. Exposed: customer names, emails, user IDs, org roles. Investigation content, credentials and session tokens reportedly untouched. Technical detail is still thin. 🔗 https://www. bleepingcomputer.com/news/secu rity/chainalysis-discloses-data-breach-from-offensive-agentic-techniques/ # DataBreach # CyberSec # AIAgents
